We need to determine SMILES of unknown compound given only description? No data provided. We have no spectra yet. We need to acquire data using tools: mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, maybe fragments. Since we have no initial guess, we need to start with mass spec to get molecular weight, then maybe DBE, then NMR to deduce structure.

We must minimize resource consumption. So start with mass spectrometry (cheapest?). Probably mass spec is cheap relative to NMR. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
